dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000rdta](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000rdta) Magnitude 6.0 earthquake at 13.895 depth occurred on Sep 30 2025 19km SW of Gayam. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -7.2395 longitude 114.1695. It impacted 516938 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
